full_judgment: 3. The plaintiff filed the aforesaid suit for declaration of his title to the lands described in schedules 1 and 2 to the plaint, for confirmation of possession in the lands of schedule 1Ka and 2Ka .and also for kash possession in the lands of schedule I Kha and 2Kha. It is his case that one Abinash Chowdhury was the owner of the superior interest of the said plots. He sold the said interest to Abu Naim who in his turn sold the same to Abdul Aziz. Abdul Aziz thereafter sold it to 8azIur Rahman. The raiyati right of the first schedule land belonged to Noor Mohammad in -/4/- annas share while charu Bala held the rest share therein. upon an amicable arrangement Charu Bala got the entire plot in her share. In Rent Execution Case No. 269 of 1950 her interest was sold in auction and purchased by one Serajuddin who took delivery of possession of the schedule 1 land in 1951. Serajuddin subsequently settled the said land in favour of the plaintiff. The raiyati right of the schedule 2 land belonged to Abdul Jabbar who mortgaged the same to Prasanna Kumar Saha. The plaintiff purchased the said land in execution of a mortgage decree and got delivery of possession thereof in 1952. The plaintiff also obtained confirmatory lease from the government who had in the meantime purchased the superior interest. He has thus been in possession of the lands of both the schedules. Defendant Nos. 3-6 are the licensees under the plaintiff in respect of schedules 1 Kha and 2Kha lands but they refused to give up possession thereof inspite of the demands made by the plain-tiff. So far as the schedule I Ka and Ma lands are concerned defendant Nos. 1 and 2 in collusion with others are trying to dispossess the plaintiff there form.
